Hire Warriors

A directory built to connect a community.

WEBFLOW / LAURA ORTEGA

A national veteran-owned business directory built in Webflow for Honorable Marketing. Structured CMS content, Jetboost search and filtering, and owner listing flows bring a complex directory together.

01 / The starting point

The starting point

A national directory needed organized listings and practical ways for visitors to find businesses by category and location.

02 / My approach

My approach

I built the Webflow CMS structure, live search and location filters with Jetboost, the owner listing flow and Enhanced Profiles. Structured data supports discovery, while the team can manage listings without a developer.
